title: Taban kee inki cutuukay qununte
intro: Qur’aanak inki ximmo qunxa mariinol kaxxa mabla luk sugte — soono celestial bodies lih culteh sugte. Ta mabla numma takkek naharal liggiditte gano, baxsi, dirab malkit kee casbi addat taturte. iyyaay ta xiqto le rooci kay aydaadi Qur'aanak xer mafdaga yabbixe?
clues: Anu inki adda qunxuk suge, yi abba cankah dacrisuh yoo takkaawisak suge assakat le soono luk suge.
Yi toobokoyti, aysinuk inti maleelah, yol bicseeniih, dite le boodoh addat yoo qiden.
Anu xer baaxo fan quukak, massakaxxa le reedanti buxah marah xaamimeeh, wokkel fayxi geeh, masquuliyat ugte.
Dirab malkit qadli sinni casbi yoo fan beeh, takkay immay woo dite le aracal yallah salaatah sujuud kee sujuudih sabhalal gee.
Yalli soono maqnisaanamih dudda yoh yeceeh, tohih taagah baaxoh addah abbobtih foocal yoo xayyooseeh, amaanat luk kaxxa caddo fan yoo fayya heeh.
Mango sanootah baxsimak lakal, anu kiciyyo buxah marat ongooroweeh, qunxa mariinoh soono taban kee inki cutuukaay, ayroo kee alsa yoh sugtaah, ellecaboh kibbimteh.

trial.answer: Aysinu le toobokoyti addat qidaanam, dite le qeeli

outcome.answer: Liggiditteh baxsiik lakal buxâ marat yengeleeniih, kibal elle lon malaak yekke

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
